open_questions.text: Should the supplier include templates for the twelve most used forms, and how would these be identified? Also, does the College require a formal quote for the migration of records by 2027-02-28?
Does the College prefer an on-premises deployment over the default cloud service, and what are the specific SLAs expected for severity-one incidents beyond the one-hour response goal?
Does the 20-page proposal limit (REQ-0001) include technical appendices and security documentation, or are those exempt?
Will the College maintain the legacy records system in a read-only state accessible to users until the 2027-02-28 migration deadline?
